name: Verify an Ed25519 JWT against a trusted key
description: Verify an EdDSA JWT using an explicit trusted accountKey, optional expected issuer/audience, and exp/nbf when present. Returns valid:false and a reason on signature, algorithm or claim rejection, without releasing claims. Malformed input fails. This is JWT validation, not venue authentication or UCAN authorization.

token.description: Compact JWT as AString/text, not a hex blob. Redacted from recorded input. Supply either token or tokenSecret.

tokenSecret.description: Secret reference containing the compact JWT: s/NAME or <did>/s/NAME. Supply either token or tokenSecret.

accountKey.description: Trusted 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey/blob, or hexadecimal string with optional 0x prefix. Obtain this key independently of the token; token headers never select a verification key.

expectedIssuer.description: Require an exact, case-sensitive iss match.

expectedAudience.description: Require an exact, case-sensitive match to aud or an entry in its string array.

requireExpiration.description: Require exp to be present. An exp that is present must always be numeric and unexpired. Set true for expiring access tokens.

reason.description: Rejection reason; never contains token data.
